sentence: Please take the bag to the school office after lunch.
synonym: bring the bag to the school office
synonymNote: bring和take都表示将包送到学校办公室，意思相同

distractors.word: leave the bag at the school office
distractors.note: leave表示留下包，不是主动送过去的动作

distractors.word: carry the bag from the school office
distractors.note: from表示从办公室拿走，方向相反

distractors.word: put the bag in the school office
distractors.note: put强调放置动作，不含送去的过程
